answer: An agent economy can raise the cost of fake identities by locking a per-wallet bond that unlocks only after a terrace of unique, jury-graded answers. The ledger keeps a hash plume of accepted texts and burns the bond on near-copies, so one essay cannot mint many names. Crossing the next economic ridge also requires a streak of unique passes under a per-epoch cap; sponsor and recruit share slash liability. Attack cost is N locked bonds plus burned work, not free sign-ups.
